title: He Turned a Box of Old Jewelry into a Solid Gold Bar 😳 (@NileRed/YT)
title_alternates: He Dissolved Gold Jewelry in Acid to See What Was Really Inside 😳 (@NileRed/YT)
This Guy Melted a Box of Old Chains into One Gold Bar 😲 (@NileRed/YT)
summary: A viewer mailed this chemist a box of old gold jewelry and asked him to turn it into a single solid bar. The stamps said he should get 77.9 grams. He got 75 — and then the scrap pile he almost threw away changed everything.

beats.line: What would happen if you dissolved a whole box of gold jewellery in acid?
Except the torch burned straight through the crucible.
Those stamps said he should end up with seventy seven grams.
Then he had to mail every single gram of it back.
